# IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono

NitroLite draws its interface in IBM Plex Sans and its figures in IBM Plex Mono. Both
are embedded in `NitroLite.exe` rather than looked up on the machine, so the window is
drawn in the same face on Windows, on Linux and on a machine that has installed nothing.

| | |
|---|---|
| Project | https://github.com/IBM/plex |
| Author | IBM Corp. |
| Files | `IBMPlexSans-Variable.ttf`, `IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf` |
| Licence | SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (reproduced below) |
| Reserved font name | "Plex" |

## Why the two licences do not conflict

The SIL Open Font License is not a copyleft licence over the software that uses the
font. It governs the font files themselves: they may be bundled, embedded and
redistributed with any program, commercial or not, provided the licence travels with
them and the reserved font name is not reused for a modified version. NitroLite ships
both files unmodified, so neither condition is strained, and NitroLite's own MIT
licence is unaffected.

The fonts are embedded as resources inside the executable. The licence text follows
this notice.
